comments.author: Kossmynn
comments.body: Piece of advice for Frankfurt event walkthrough: launch the japan wiki of the game with google translate and write "Live event" in the "search" option. Then choose Live Event/BeerFest 2013. U'll see the description of the event, the full list of rewards etc. Of course, use google translate if u'r not proficient in Japanese.
